title: Vault notes: no filler words, aliases folded in, no dangling links (#1387)
body:
Fixes #1387.

`memory-views.js` decides which remembered entities get a note in the vault's `Views/Entities/`, using what the store already knows. It adds no new ontology.
- **Dropped:** entities typed `not_an_entity`.
- **Aliases** (`canonicalKey`) fold into their canonical entity. Their mentions are merged, and the note keeps the canonical name.
- **Untyped candidates:** a filler word (and, but, because, actually…) never gets a note. Any other single word needs two mentions; a multi-word name needs one. A typed entity always stays, even one named like a filler word. Only English filler is listed, so non-English names are never treated as filler.
- **Links:** notes and Key Facts link only to notes that exist. Key Facts also match aliases.
- **`GET /api/memory/notes/excluded`** lists what got no note and why.
- **Cleanup:** `refreshViews` already removes obsolete notes Mana owns and never touches mine, so a filler note she made earlier is cleaned up on the next refresh.

Tests: `test/memory-views.test.js` covers filler words, words that are also real names, non-English names, typed vs untyped, aliases, and no dangling links. One existing Key Facts test now types its single-mention entity. All run in CI.
interface: The merged change for PR #1395 is covered by test/memory-views.test.js, test/server-routes.test.js.
why: Additional real merged-fix benchmark case selected to broaden the agentic coding evaluation.
